Title: Generally Available: Azure SQL hub experience in Azure portal

Body.Content:
Choosing the right Azure SQL service can be challenging. To make this easier, you can now visit the Azure SQL hub, a new home for everything related to Azure SQL in the Azure portal. 

Whether you’re new to Azure SQL or an experienced user, the hub helps you find the right service quickly and decide, without disrupting your existing workflows. If you’re new to Azure SQL, the hub is your home page where you can get personalized recommendations by answering a few quick questions or chatting with Copilot in Azure. You can also compare services side by side and explore key resources—all without leaving the portal. 

If you’re an existing Azure SQL user, your current workflows remain unchanged. You’ll see a streamlined navigation pane when you access Azure SQL resources. 

Learn more.
